mission: Matrix Reprogrammed is a public accountability system where anyone can search a consequence, trace it backwards through decisions, authority and money, follow the unanswered questions, and return to see what actually happened.
publicPromise: Search the consequence. Trace the power. Follow the outcome.

systems.name: Reverse Accountability Search
systems.purpose: Let a reader begin with a consequence, cost, closure, restriction, contract, policy outcome or lived problem and trace backwards to implementation, decisions, authority, money, beneficiaries, affected groups and unresolved questions.
systems.uniqueBehavior: The user does not need to know the powerful person or institution before beginning the investigation.
systems.currentCapability: Searches current Accountability Twins and public-source leads, renders a six-step backwards evidence path and links each result to its responsibility chain.

systems.name: Power Supply Chain
systems.purpose: Map who proposed, drafted, promoted, authorised, funded, implemented and benefited from an exercise of power, while distinguishing authority from access or association.
systems.uniqueBehavior: Responsibility is represented as an evidence-classified chain of authority and implementation rather than a generic social network.
systems.currentCapability: Builds ten-stage chains for every reverse-search record, visibly preserves unresolved stages and blocks authority claims based only on access, association or proximity.

systems.name: Evidence Half-Life
systems.purpose: Track when supporting records were last verified, whether they remain accessible and whether ownership, office, law or material context has changed.
systems.uniqueBehavior: Claims lose prominence or receive a recall notice when their evidence becomes stale, unavailable or contradicted.

systems.name: Power Diff
systems.purpose: Show a Git-style record of what was added, changed, ended, disputed or corrected in a power record since the previous version.
systems.uniqueBehavior: Readers can see the exact material change rather than rereading an entire dossier.

systems.name: Red-Team Mirror
systems.purpose: Generate the strongest evidence-based case supporting and challenging every significant conclusion before publication.
systems.uniqueBehavior: The investigation system must attempt to disprove its own preferred conclusion and publish the strongest plausible alternative explanation.

systems.name: Public Answer Clock
systems.purpose: Keep a precise public-interest question attached to the permanent record, including who was asked, when it was delivered, whether a response arrived and what remains unanswered.
systems.uniqueBehavior: The question remains live and followable after the news cycle ends; non-response is never treated as proof of wrongdoing.

systems.name: Missing Record Missions
systems.purpose: Convert evidence gaps into specific public research missions naming the record needed, likely custodian, jurisdiction, search terms, request route and resolution status.
systems.uniqueBehavior: Readers contribute to defined evidence gaps instead of posting unstructured speculation.

systems.name: Lived Consequence Receipts
systems.purpose: Allow privacy-protected submissions showing how a decision affected real people through bills, notices, correspondence, service changes or other verifiable records.
systems.uniqueBehavior: Individual receipts remain clearly classified and can reveal corroborated patterns without pretending that one submission proves a general outcome.

nonNegotiableRules: Facts, official allegations, documented associations, inference, rumours and speculation must remain separately classified.
Association, proximity and network membership must never be converted into guilt.
Every material conclusion must state what the evidence establishes, what it does not establish, alternative explanations and what evidence would change the conclusion.
No automated outcome verdict may be published without accepted evidence and named human review.
Corrections, counter-evidence, right of reply and version history remain attached to the public record.
Privacy-protected lived evidence must be redacted, consent-bounded and separately classified from general statistical evidence.
